notes.title: Outland Gunboat V3.0 Update - Added Zombie Mode
notes.content:
1. Added zombie mode, where you can build giant towers amidst the zombie horde. And choose to switch control gunboats, helicopters, and armored vehicles
2. Three new weapon unlocking options have been added, including parent-child shells, sniper shells, and bouncing shells

notes.title: Update Description for Xenon Gunboat V2.00 Version - Added Online Mode
notes.content: 1. Added online mode, where you can compete with friends to see which team can achieve the maximum coloring area. Seizing neutral units helps with coloring. The homeowner can set the game time and the number of neutral units.

notes.title: Update Description for V1.10 Version
notes.content:
1. Added a skeleton option (disabled by default). After killing enemies, the skeleton will decompose and be preserved, and the remains can be knocked away. But it has a significant impact on performance. If it cannot be carried, it is recommended to turn it off.
2. Ranking pagination to reduce lag during reading
3. Upgrade the panel and add animations when they appear
4. Special weapon addition icon prompt in the upper right corner

notes.title: V1.01 version update
notes.content:
V1.01 update point
1. Now, even if you voluntarily exit the pause interface, you can still settle the game
2. Now a sound effect prompt will be added before upgrading
3. View restriction prompt icon optimization
We will continue to update and optimize in the future
